title: New Kernel Stabilized Bound
statement: theorem coherentFormalModule_kernel_stabilized_bound {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] (I : X.IdealSheafData) (F H : CoherentFormalModule X I) (α : F ⟶ H) : ∃ c : ℕ, ∀ (l m : ℕ) (h : m + c ≤ l), Subobject.mk (Abelian.image.ι (kernel.ι (α.hom.app (op l)) ≫ F.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_add_right m c) h)).op)) = Subobject.mk (Abelian.image.ι (kernel.ι (α.hom.app (op (m + c))) ≫ F.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_add_right m c)).op))

proof.text: Use compactness of the Noetherian scheme and the affine-open basis to choose a finite affine subcover s. For each affine U obtain a local bound c(U) from new-formal-kernel-affine-bound. Set C to the finite supremum of these bounds (zero for the empty cover).

Fix l >= m+C and U in s. Since c(U) <= C, apply the local bound both at l and at m+C, with the same base level m. Both local section ranges equal the range at m+c(U), hence they equal each other on every W contained in U. No monotonicity or surjectivity of images is assumed here; equality is transitive.

Apply module_subobject_eq_on_cover to the two image inclusions and the chosen finite cover. The local equalities from the preceding step identify their global subobjects. This proves the original signature unchanged.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 087X, proof of claim (a): affine localization and Artin--Rees calculation
